entities.name: Mizoram
entities.description: Northeastern Indian state bordering Myanmar and Bangladesh, predominantly Mizo (Christian, tribal) population; a former Union Territory that became a full state in 1987 under the 1986 Mizoram Peace Accord.

entities.name: Government of Mizoram
entities.description: The executive government of the State of Mizoram, headed by the Governor as constitutional head and the Chief Minister as head of government.

entities.name: Mizoram Council of Ministers
entities.description: Council of Ministers advising the Governor of Mizoram, headed by Chief Minister Lalduhoma (ZPM) since 8 December 2023; all members are from the Zoram People's Movement.
entities.legalBasis: Article 164, Constitution of India (capped at 12 members per Article 164(1A) for a 40-seat assembly)

entities.name: Mizoram Legislative Assembly
entities.description: Unicameral 40-seat legislature of Mizoram, founded 10 May 1972; current (9th) Assembly elected 7 November 2023, term runs to 2028.

entities.name: Mizoram State Election Commission
entities.description: Constitutional body conducting elections to Mizoram's Village Councils and Urban Local Bodies (municipalities), independent of the state government.

entities.name: Mizoram Public Service Commission
entities.description: Constitutional body conducting recruitment examinations and advising the state government on civil service matters in Mizoram.

entities.name: Mizoram Lokayukta
entities.description: Anti-corruption ombudsman investigating complaints against public functionaries in Mizoram; a three-member body headed by a current/former High Court Chief Justice or judge.
entities.legalBasis: Mizoram Lokayukta and Deputy Lokayukta Act, 2014 (effective Nov 2014)

entities.name: Aizawl Municipal Corporation
entities.description: Sole municipal corporation in Mizoram, governing the state capital Aizawl; upgraded from Aizawl Municipal Council in 2010.
entities.notes: A fresh Wikipedia fetch (page last updated 2026-09-23) indicates Aizawl held a municipal election in 2026 in which ZPM won 17 seats -- this postdates the 'seats: 19' figure recorded here (from the prior council), which was NOT independently reconfirmed for the new term; treat total-seat count as possibly stale. The mayor holder (H. Lalremtluanga, ZPM) matches both the old and new sources so was not changed.

entities.name: Nagaland

entities.name: Government of Nagaland
entities.description: The executive government of Nagaland, headed by the Governor as constitutional head and the Chief Minister as head of an NDPP-led, all-party coalition government (no formal opposition since the 2023 election).

entities.name: Nagaland Council of Ministers (Fifth Rio ministry)

entities.name: Nagaland Public Service Commission

entities.name: Tripura

entities.name: Government of Tripura

entities.name: Tripura Legislative Assembly

entities.name: Tripura Lokayukta

entities.name: Agartala Municipal Corporation
